_maxWorkers: Every suite boots its own in-memory mongod REPLICA SET, so the ceiling is how many of those the machine can host — a memory limit, not a CPU one, which is why this is a fixed number and not a percentage of cores. It is also close to the edge: on a 12-core box 4 passed with 25 suites and then crashed once a 26th was added, with `Mongod internal error (fassert() failure)` taking hundreds of tests down. 3 passes 463/463 in ~110s across three consecutive runs; 2 passes in ~176s if a smaller machine needs the margin. ADDING A SUITE MAY REQUIRE LOWERING THIS — re-run the whole file a few times before trusting a raise, because a single green run is not evidence.
